test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Rishi and Rahul are twins / but both do not take off / the kindness and generosity / of their parents.

options.text: but both do not take off

solution:
The correct answer is: "**but both do not take off**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in this segment is related to the use of the negative word "**not**."
 
• In English, when expressing a negative idea, it's more common to use "**neither**" instead of "**both**" in a sentence like this.
 
• Therefore, it should be: "**but neither take off**."
 
• This correction maintains the negative meaning and is grammatically accurate.
 
• **The revised sentence would be**: "*Rishi and Rahul are twins, but neither take off the kindness and generosity of their parents.*"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
